source.title: One Night in Winterspring
source.description: Just having a tent won't be enough to survive the night in a Winterspring storm. You'll need food, furs, and fire to keep warm, or you'll freeze to death while you wait. Fortunately, nature provides everything you'll need, and you can forage for it all right here.
source.objective:
Collect bear meat, warm fur, and dry wood. Bring the materials back to your campsite to construct a shelter so that you can survive the storm.

If you lose your foundation, make a new one with your survival supplies and bring the materials there.

Provided item:
source.progress: You'll need enough food, fur, and fire to survive the night without freezing to death.
source.completion: With the additional supplies, it should be possible to camp through the storm.
